proposals.title: Improve shareholder written consent
proposals.topic_summary: Requests enabling 10% of shares to request a record date to initiate written consent, and reduce supermajority barriers to shareholder action outside annual meetings.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Racial equity audit and report
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a racial equity audit analyzing JPMorgan's adverse impacts on nonwhite stakeholders and communities of color, with a publicly disclosed report.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Independent board chairman
proposals.proponent: John Chevedden, on behalf of Kenneth Steiner
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy and bylaw amendment requiring the Board Chair, whenever possible, to be an independent director.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Political and electioneering expenditure congruency report
proposals.proponent: Rhia Ventures on behalf of Jonathan Weinstock
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual report analyzing congruency of political and electioneering expenditures with publicly stated company values, including brand and reputation risk analysis.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.
